content: उत्क्षेपणम् .²1 Throwing upwards, lifting or tossing up; अतिमात्रलोहिततलौ बाहू घटोत्क्षेपणात् <ls>Ś. 1. 29</ls>. .²2 Throwing upwards, regarded by the Vaiśeṣikas as one of the five {%karmans%} <ab>q. v.</ab> .²3 Vomiting. .²4 Sending away, despatching. .²5 A kind of basket for cleaning corn; a kind of stick for threshing corn. .²6 A fan. .²7 A measure of sixteen Paṇas.
